home.headline: From Geneva, I build software that holds.

intro.paragraph: I design, build and run web applications in TypeScript, from enterprise integrations to the ticketing platform of a race I founded. I work from the first requirement to production, with an architecture that stays readable and a delivery that stays calm, so that teams can focus on what matters.

about.hook: Software engineer by day, race organiser on the side.
about.text: I joined JCDecaux in 2023 and build internal tools used across several countries. Alongside, I founded Overbound, an obstacle-course race, and ran it end to end: logistics, partners, volunteers, finance, communication and the ticketing platform I wrote myself.
